nodes.label: GLOBALGRID2050 architecture
nodes.reason: The map of maps: 15 graphs of the estate's code, its reuse, its blocks, its tests and its decisions. Tap a card's External road to open that graph.

nodes.label: Federation
nodes.reason: The federation-spider's own root graph, copied verbatim from data-federation-map-for-globalgrid2050-all-repos so the page has something real to show on first load.

nodes.label: globalgrid2050 contents
nodes.reason: The declared contents cartridge for the globalgrid2050 repo, copied verbatim.

nodes.label: Engine population
nodes.reason: The ventus-grid-engine population graph: the engine's canonical modules and the copies, drifts and should-imports they replace across the estate.

nodes.label: genome-spider output
nodes.reason: The estate genome published by spiders/species/genome-spider: repositories and their significant internal units (workflows, manifests, data products, scripts, proofs, modules, parts) as cards, wired by every dependency the spider could evidence (pinned actions, workflow checkouts, manifest paths, JSON provenance, imports, fetches).

nodes.label: GridAtlas cartridge lineage
nodes.reason: GridAtlas's current composition and its ancestry: which cartridges it composed, which parts/modules built each cartridge, and any part whose content has moved on since that cartridge was last built. Verified 2026-09-04 HTTP 200, first read live from the spider's published output (current counts: see measured).

nodes.label: Reuse
nodes.reason: Functions and classes found in two or more different files across the public Ventusltd repositories, wired to the repositories they live in and to other families sharing their name. Verified 2026-09-23 HTTP 200, 298 nodes / 996 edges.

nodes.label: Inventory
nodes.reason: Every block of globalgrid2050 architecture development with a permanent number and a plain-language description, grouped by category and wired to the repositories it lives in. Verified 2026-09-23 HTTP 200, 392 nodes / 1277 edges.

nodes.label: Audit
nodes.reason: What ran, when, what it produced and which checks it passed: the workflows, their latest runs and their artefacts. Verified 2026-09-23 HTTP 200, 40 nodes / 68 edges.

nodes.label: Structure
nodes.reason: globalgrid2050 architecture development, top-down: repositories, the blocks in each, and the engine modules in their canonical order. Verified 2026-09-23 HTTP 200, 127 nodes / 368 edges.

nodes.label: Compatibility
nodes.reason: Which combinations of GridAtlas components always work, which fail, and the error each failure produces. Verified 2026-09-23 HTTP 200, 125 nodes / 129 edges.

nodes.label: Classification
nodes.reason: The five classes of the code (structure, movement, computation, flow, data), what is never used, and whether each test loaded the map's parts in the declared order. Verified 2026-09-23 HTTP 200, 305 nodes / 300 edges.

nodes.label: Sampling
nodes.reason: Randomly chosen links between components, for tripping over dependencies nobody wrote down. Verified 2026-09-23 HTTP 200, 169 nodes / 150 edges.

nodes.label: Applications
nodes.reason: Apps built from blocks of the periodic table, wired to the blocks they are made of and the work orders still open. Verified 2026-09-23 HTTP 200, 14 nodes / 12 edges.

nodes.label: Assessment
nodes.reason: The code universe charted into sense: what is canonical and what is a copy, what depends on what, what is proven together and what is untested, what is a decision rather than a fact. Verified 2026-09-23 HTTP 200, 142 nodes / 566 edges.

nodes.label: Decisions
nodes.reason: The judgements attached to the maps' permanent keys: one card per decision record, open (amber), decided (green) or superseded (grey), wired to the block, constant or function family it concerns. Verified 2026-09-23 HTTP 200, 33 nodes / 35 edges.
